title: Finite separable extension from a trivializing datum
statement: Given a field $k$, finite commutative ring $\\Lambda$, sheaf $G$, a $LocallyConstantDatum\\ d$ for $G$, and finite constant module values on every member of the datum cover, there exist a finite separable field extension $K/k$, a finite $\\Lambda$-module $M$, and an isomorphism of the pullback of $G$ to $\\operatorname{Spec}K$ with the constant sheaf of value $M$.

proof.text: Choose i and y in the etale cover above the unique point of Spec k using Cover.exists_eq. Set U = d.cover.X i and f = d.cover.f i; its etaleness is d.cover.map_prop i.

Set K = U.residueField y with k-algebra structure (f.residueFieldAlgebraMap y).toAlgebra. The algebra map k to the affine residue field at f(y) is bijective by Ideal.algEquivResidueFieldOfField, and the inverse of Scheme.Spec.residueFieldIso is bijective. Compose these two etale isomorphisms with f.etale_residueFieldMap y (the already proved library theorem in WeilConjectures.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Morphisms.FormallyUnramified). By RingHom.Etale.stableUnderComposition the structure map k to K is etale. Mathlib Algebra.FormallyUnramified.finite_of_free and Algebra.FormallyEtale.iff_isSeparable give finite dimensionality and separability. By the proved library theorem f.specMap_residueFieldAlgebraMap y, Spec(algebraMap k K) equals U.fromSpecResidueField y followed by f.

Choose the finite module M and localized trivialization e from hd i. Transport e through Etale.overSheafEquiv. Compose overSheafEquivFunctorObjOverIso.symm, its image of e, and Equivalence.constantSheafSheafCongrIso at M to obtain an isomorphism f^*G with the constant sheaf of the same value M on U. These are already implemented comparisons of the localized and small etale sites; no change of module value is needed.

Write g = U.fromSpecResidueField y. Rewrite Spec(algebraMap k K) as g followed by f using the equality above. Compose Etale.upperStarComp at G, the image of the isomorphism in the preceding step under g^*, and upperStarConstantSheafIso at M. This is the required isomorphism on Spec K. Return K, its field and algebra structures, finite dimensionality, separability, and the original M with its unchanged finiteness proof.

lean.statement:
theorem constructible_field_finite_separable_constant_of_datum
    (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    (G : Sheaf (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).smallEtaleTopology
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (d : LocallyConstantDatum G)
    (hd : ∀ i : d.cover.I₀,
      ∃ M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ, Finite M ∧
        Nonempty ((G.over (d.cover.etalePrecoverageToEtale i)) ≅
          (constantSheaf
            ((Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).smallEtaleTopology.over
              (d.cover.etalePrecoverageToEtale i))
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)) :
    ∃ (K : Type u), ∃ (_ : Field K), ∃ (_ : Algebra k K),
      FiniteDimensional k K ∧ Algebra.IsSeparable k K ∧
      ∃ (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ), Finite M ∧
        Nonempty
          ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).obj G ≅
            (constantSheaf (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).smallEtaleTopology
              (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)
